items.label: About LIVING HERITAGE
items.content: This virtual exhibition brings together three videopoems that transform literary texts into immersive audiovisual works, presenting videopoetry as both an artistic practice and a didactic medium for transmitting cultural heritage across languages, media and cultural contexts. Developed through workshops organised within Communities and Artistic Participation in Hybrid Environments (CAPHE, 2023-2025), the exhibition explores how poetry may be reactivated through the interplay of word, image and sound, generating new forms of interpretation and encounter. This archival space documents an exhibition presented simultaneously in two connected formats from 19 to 27 November 2025: as an on-site installation at the Gallery of the Faculty of Fine Arts of the University of Lisbon (Faculdade de Belas-Artes da Universidade de Lisboa) and as a virtual environment in Spacial. Curated by Justyna Gorzkowicz and Jarosław Solecki, the exhibition brought together three videopoems based on works by Stanisław Młodożeniec, Stanisław Vincenz, and Fernando Pessoa with his heteronyms, showing how literary texts can be reimagined through audiovisual form, translation, collaboration and workshop-based practice. The works presented were Jedna ziemia / One Earth, based on Stanisław Młodożeniec's poem W drodze (On the Road); Echoes of a Father, based on Stanisław Vincenz's poetic interpretation of The Lord's Prayer; and Disappearing Mirrors, a collaborative videopoem based on poems by Fernando Pessoa and his heteronyms, developed with students from the Faculty of Fine Arts of the University of Lisbon and the team from the Polish University Abroad (PUNO) in London. Distinctly polyphonic in structure, Disappearing Mirrors combines multiple visual, textual and vocal contributions. It includes Ode Triunfal Redux by Tiago Mendonça, Na Floresta do Alheamento by Carlota Bonito, Estátuas Invisíveis by Margarida Leal, inspired by Cul de Lampe by Álvaro de Campos, and a video by Patrícia Dias based on Tabacaria by Álvaro de Campos. Additional textual layers include Mar Português and Autopsicografia. The work also incorporates Greek translation by Agnieszka Szajner, Italian translation by Giulia Lanciani, vocal contributions by Giuseppe Caprioti, Ellodie Cheikh and Agnieszka Szajner, and editing by Justyna Gorzkowicz and Jarosław Solecki. Although each piece adopts a different strategy, all three are grounded in the same premise: that poetry can move beyond the printed page and be experienced as rhythm, voice, image, movement and audiovisual composition. In this sense, the exhibition presents the videopoem as a medium for the remediation of literary heritage and as a space in which new readings may emerge. Living Heritage proposes that literary works continue to live not only through reading and interpretation, but also through audiovisual transformation, multilingual transmission and shared artistic practice across physical and virtual environments.

cues.text:
Welcome to the Blue Point Art archive
and to Living Heritage
remediating through video poetry.

You are now entering the archival version
of an exhibition presented from

19 to 20 7th November 2025,
both at the Gallery of the Faculty of Fine

Arts of the University of Lisbon,
and in spatial.

In this gallery
you will encounter three video
poems, each lasting around five minutes.

The works are based on texts
by Stanislaw Młodożeniec,

Stanislaw Vincenz
and Fernando Pessoa with his heteronyms.

Each video poem is accompanied by a short
description.

You can also open the sidebar to find
further information about the exhibition.
Read the curatorial text and download
a PDF version of the exhibition materials.

A working English
translation of the text used in One
Earth is also available there, along

with further information about the authors
whose works are reimagined in the video.
Poems.

This exhibition invites you into a journey
through literary heritage,

reimagined through image,
sound, rhythm and voice.

Here, the video poem becomes a medium
through which poetry can be revisited,
reinterpreted and experienced in new ways.

You are welcome to move through the space
at your own pace, and begin
with any of the works around you.
Thank you for visiting and we hope you enjoy your journey through living heritage.

Witamy w archiwum Blue Point Art
i w Living Heritage
remediując poprzez wideopoezję.

Wchodzisz teraz do archiwalnej wersji
wystawy prezentowanej od

19 do 27 listopada 2025 roku,
zarówno w Galerii Wydziału Sztuk Pięknych

Uniwersytetu Lizbońskiego,
jak i w Spatial.

W tej galerii
spotkasz trzy wideo
poematy, z których każdy trwa około pięciu minut.

Prace oparte są na tekstach
Stanisława Młodożeńca,

Stanisława Vincenza
i Fernanda Pessoi wraz z jego heteronimami.

Każdemu wideopoematowi towarzyszy krótki
opis.

Możesz także otworzyć panel boczny, aby znaleźć
więcej informacji o wystawie.
Przeczytaj tekst kuratorski i pobierz
wersję PDF materiałów wystawy.

Robocze angielskie
tłumaczenie tekstu użytego w One
Earth jest tam również dostępne, wraz

z dodatkowymi informacjami o autorach,
których utwory zostały przetworzone w wideo.
poematach.

Ta wystawa zaprasza cię w podróż
przez dziedzictwo literackie,

wyobrażone na nowo poprzez obraz,
dźwięk, rytm i głos.

Tutaj wideopoemat staje się medium,
przez które poezję można odwiedzić ponownie,

zinterpretować na nowo i doświadczyć
w nowy sposób.

Zapraszamy do poruszania się po przestrzeni
własnym tempem i rozpoczęcia
od dowolnej pracy wokół ciebie.
Dziękujemy za wizytę i życzymy udanej podróży przez Living Heritage.

Bem-vindo ao arquivo Blue Point Art
e ao Living Heritage
remediando através da videopoesia.

Está agora a entrar na versão arquivística
de uma exposição apresentada de

19 a 27 de novembro de 2025,
tanto na Galeria da Faculdade de Belas-Artes

da Universidade de Lisboa,
como no Spatial.

Nesta galeria
irá encontrar três vídeo
poemas, cada um com cerca de cinco minutos.

As obras baseiam-se em textos
de Stanisław Młodożeniec,

Stanisław Vincenz
e Fernando Pessoa com os seus heterónimos.

Cada videopoema é acompanhado por uma breve
descrição.

Também pode abrir a barra lateral para encontrar
mais informações sobre a exposição.
Leia o texto curatorial e descarregue
uma versão PDF dos materiais da exposição.

Uma tradução provisória para inglês
do texto usado em One
Earth também está disponível ali, juntamente

com mais informações sobre os autores
cujas obras são reimaginadas no vídeo.
Poemas.

Esta exposição convida-o a uma viagem
pelo património literário,

reimaginado através da imagem,
do som, do ritmo e da voz.

Aqui, o videopoema torna-se um meio
através do qual a poesia pode ser revisitada,

reinterpretada e experienciada
de novas formas.

Pode percorrer o espaço
ao seu próprio ritmo e começar
por qualquer uma das obras à sua volta.
Obrigado pela sua visita e esperamos que desfrute da sua viagem pelo Living Heritage.

Benvenuti nell'archivio Blue Point Art
e in Living Heritage
rimediare attraverso la videopoesia.

Stai entrando ora nella versione archivistica
di una mostra presentata dal

19 al 27 novembre 2025,
sia presso la Galleria della Facoltà di Belle Arti

dell'Università di Lisbona,
sia in Spatial.

In questa galleria
incontrerai tre video
poemi, ciascuno della durata di circa cinque minuti.

Le opere sono basate su testi
di Stanisław Młodożeniec,

Stanisław Vincenz
e Fernando Pessoa con i suoi eteronimi.

Ogni videopoema è accompagnato da una breve
descrizione.

Puoi anche aprire la barra laterale per trovare
ulteriori informazioni sulla mostra.
Leggi il testo curatoriale e scarica
una versione PDF dei materiali della mostra.

Una traduzione inglese provvisoria
del testo usato in One
Earth è disponibile anche lì, insieme

a ulteriori informazioni sugli autori
le cui opere sono reimmaginate nel video.
Poemi.

Questa mostra ti invita a un viaggio
attraverso il patrimonio letterario,

reimmaginato attraverso immagine,
suono, ritmo e voce.

Qui il videopoema diventa un mezzo
attraverso cui la poesia può essere rivisitata,

reinterpretata e vissuta
in modi nuovi.

Sei invitato a muoverti nello spazio
al tuo ritmo e a cominciare
da una qualsiasi delle opere intorno a te.
Grazie per la visita e speriamo che tu possa goderti il viaggio attraverso Living Heritage.

Καλώς ήρθατε στο αρχείο Blue Point Art
και στο Living Heritage
αναδιαμεσολαβώντας μέσα από τη βιντεοποίηση.

Τώρα εισέρχεστε στην αρχειακή εκδοχή
μιας έκθεσης που παρουσιάστηκε από

19 έως 27 Νοεμβρίου 2025,
τόσο στην Πινακοθήκη της Σχολής Καλών Τεχνών

του Πανεπιστημίου της Λισαβόνας,
όσο και στο Spatial.

Σε αυτή την γκαλερί
θα συναντήσετε τρία βίντεο
ποιήματα, το καθένα διάρκειας περίπου πέντε λεπτών.

Τα έργα βασίζονται σε κείμενα
του Stanisław Młodożeniec,

του Stanisław Vincenz
και του Fernando Pessoa με τα ετερώνυμά του.

Κάθε βιντεοποίημα συνοδεύεται από μια σύντομη
περιγραφή.

Μπορείτε επίσης να ανοίξετε την πλαϊνή μπάρα για να βρείτε
περισσότερες πληροφορίες για την έκθεση.
Διαβάστε το επιμελητικό κείμενο και κατεβάστε
μια έκδοση PDF του υλικού της έκθεσης.

Μια πρόχειρη αγγλική
μετάφραση του κειμένου που χρησιμοποιείται στο One
Earth είναι επίσης διαθέσιμη εκεί, μαζί

με περισσότερες πληροφορίες για τους συγγραφείς
των οποίων τα έργα επανερμηνεύονται στο βίντεο.
Ποιήματα.

Αυτή η έκθεση σας προσκαλεί σε ένα ταξίδι
μέσα από τη λογοτεχνική κληρονομιά,

ξαναφαντασμένη μέσα από την εικόνα,
τον ήχο, τον ρυθμό και τη φωνή.

Εδώ, το βιντεοποίημα γίνεται ένα μέσο
μέσα από το οποίο η ποίηση μπορεί να επανεξεταστεί,

να επανερμηνευτεί και να βιωθεί
με νέους τρόπους.

Είστε ευπρόσδεκτοι να κινηθείτε στον χώρο
με τον δικό σας ρυθμό και να ξεκινήσετε
με οποιοδήποτε από τα έργα γύρω σας.
Σας ευχαριστούμε για την επίσκεψη και ελπίζουμε να απολαύσετε το ταξίδι σας στο Living Heritage.
